test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

I don’t think / I can go throughout / the process of raising / two children on my own.
solution:
The correct answer is **"I can go throughout". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence is the incorrect use of **"throughout" **which is mistakenly used instead of **"through".**
 
• **"Throughout" **means **"in every part," **or **"during the whole time or extent." **
 
• However, in the context of the sentence, the intended meaning is **"to undergo" **or **"to go through" **a process or experience.
 
• **"Through" **is the correct word to express moving from one end or side of something to the other.
 
• It is correctly used to describe undergoing a process or an experience.
 
• The corrected segment of the sentence should be **"I can go through the process of raising".**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 ("Two children on my own"):** This segment is grammatically correct.

 
 
• It correctly indicates that the speaker is contemplating the challenges of raising two children independently.
 
 
 
• **Option 2 ("The process of raising"): **This segment is grammatically correct and appropriately describes the concept of nurturing or bringing up children, which is a continuous and often challenging process.
 
• **Option 3 ("I don’t think"): **This segment is grammatically correct.
 
 
• It is used here to express the speaker's doubt or hesitation about the ability to manage the situation described.
